# Synthetic protocol cases

All values are hand-made for offline tests and have no real account mapping.
`Status` examples reuse existing P0 test values, not verified broker error codes.
`Wtrq` and `Wtbh` names and their concatenation derive from the cancel_order
docstring; the sample is not evidence of a complete actual response schema.
Actual account, login failure and cancellation response schemas are unknown.
Never record live responses or credentials here.
